en: Color postcard view from a wooded hillside lookout with a rustic wooden fence in the foreground, overlooking a bright blue lake. On a small peninsula near the center is a village with red-roofed houses and a prominent church with a tall steeple. Forested hills and distant mountains surround the lake. In the sky area near the top, red printed text reads the name of the place.
